attributes.action: Fund dedicated residential addiction rehabilitation for under-18s
attributes.additional_details:
We are concerned that children under 18 struggling with addiction are being left without the specialist rehabilitation they desperately need. Some families are watching their children become seriously unwell while waiting for help or being told they are too young.
 
We believe we need Government-funded rehab centres providing addiction treatment, mental health and trauma support, education, life skills and aftercare.
 
Children deserve the chance to recover and rebuild their futures. They should not have to wait until 18 to get more help.
attributes.background: Require the Government to fund specialist addiction rehabilitation for under-18s, including dedicated residential rehab placements where needed. Services must include addiction treatment, mental health support, education, life skills and ongoing aftercare for young people and their families.
